identification: Complete set of seven hand-painted German porcelain figures, Henry VIII and his six wives, about 17-20 cm, on round white bases with gilt lines: Henry (black feathered cap, ermine-trimmed cloak, gilt chain, dagger, leg support moulded with gilt chevrons), and six wives in orange, teal/plum, blue/lilac floral, crimson/ermine, green with red lattice underskirt, and purple with green diamond underskirt. Form, palette and Henry's chevron support match the Sitzendorf (Thuringia) Henry VIII set exactly: I compared against the photo of a sold Sitzendorf 'Set of Seven' (eBay UK item 186789248898) and it is the same model set. Catalogue estimate A$30-60, current bid A$15.
